    "failure_scenario": "SchemaBuilder::defineDocumentRevisions / defineDocuments / defineNodeComments are member-owned by documents, and defineWebhookDeliveries / defineWebhookEndpoints by webhooks. They reference core types (IdStrategy, HostKeyColumns, DatabaseConfig). documents.target_require and webhooks.target_require are only [drive], so core is transitive and the row is correctly needs-explicit-require. The reason on all 10 rows says core imports core and that P4 must add require core to composer core, so the fix is applied to the wrong package.",
    "basis": "p2-design#scans I2 target: a direct import of a package that is only in the transitive target_require closure is category needs-explicit-require, naming the owner that lacks the direct require. ScanContext::ownerAt prefers the member owner (ScanContext.php:107). The scanner category matches that owner; the hand reason uses the file's package (core) instead. | repro: Python join of i2.json to target-map members/types and packages.json: reason mismatches 10, histogram (('core','documents','core','core'), 7), (('core','webhooks','core','core'), 3); category recomputed from ownerAt vs target_require/closure mismatches 0. First row symbol Vaulter\\Schema\\SchemaBuilder::defineDocumentRevisions target Vaulter\\Contracts\\IdStrategy. target-map.json:750 owner documents. inventory.php fk scan-i1 scan-i2 scan-i3 scan-i4 --check printed [scan-i2] ok, CHECK_EXIT:0. Entries omit target_owner, and Allowlist::compare keys only view|file|symbol|kind|target plus count, so the wrong sentence is not checked."
  },

    "severity": "low",
    "confidence": "confirmed",
    "location": "tests/Repo/Arch/Fixtures/allowlists/i1.json:514",
    "failure_scenario": "Vaulter\\Database\\Factories\\VaulterFactory is target-map action keep, phase stay, owner core, target_fqcn unchanged. Five i1 rows (file-level use plus VaulterFactory::system / ::withTenant) say the factories move to the model owners. A reader following the reason moves an Api type the map keeps.",
    "basis": "I1 target lists only symbols whose target-map owner is core, i.e. code that stays. kernel-needs-contract matches a kept factory that must stop naming drive types. The reason states the opposite move. removed_in P4 is within the I1 block, so --check stays green. | repro: target-map.json:3788-3798 action keep, phase stay, owner core, file packages/core/database/factories/VaulterFactory.php. i1.json:514 reason \"фабрики ядра создают доменные модели: фабрики переезжают к владельцам моделей (цель: drive)\" category kernel-needs-contract. Same reason on the five VaulterFactory rows. I1 goal-vs-target-owner check was 0 mismatches; the false part is the move claim, not цель: drive."

P2.4.json result (line 212) has executor/started_at only; no notes field. U5.json tells the unit to record v_blobs.drive_id in the item notes."
